title: Filters
orGroupCustomFieldsOnly: An "any of" group can only combine custom fields - Paperless has no way to express OR across core document fields.
unsupportedNode: This filter contains a condition this version cannot display or run.
notCompilableBody: The filter itself is fine - Paperless has no way to express this exact question, so PaperWrench will not run an approximation of it.

values.greater_or_equal: is greater than or equal to
values.less_or_equal: is less than or equal to

values.text:equals: Case-insensitive: Paperless does not expose exact case-sensitive equality for text.
values.long_text:equals: Case-insensitive: Paperless does not expose exact case-sensitive equality for text.
values.url:equals: Case-insensitive: Paperless does not expose exact case-sensitive equality for text.
values.monetary:equals: Compared as a number without currency: EUR10.00 and USD10.00 are equal for this condition.
values.monetary:greater_than: Compared as a number without currency.
values.datetime:equals: Compared as the whole calendar day, not an exact timestamp.
values.reference:not_equals: Documents without a value also match because they do not contain the excluded value.
values.tag_set:has_all_of: The document has every listed tag.
values.tag_set:has_any_of: The document has at least one listed tag.
values.tag_set:has_none_of: The document has none of the listed tags.
values.tag_set:is_present: The document has at least one tag.
values.reference:is_missing: No value is set on the document.
values.reference:is_present: A value is set on the document.

values.title: Full-text search limited to the document title.
values.content: Full-text search in extracted document content.
values.advanced: Raw Paperless query syntax, passed through without modification or validation by PaperWrench.
